params.message:
Lighter hero, company details from Sanity, service gallery, simpler sell page, Brandweer and Personenwagens

- Home hero: shade only behind the text from lg on, an even veil below; white
  eyebrow with an orange bar. All hero text passes WCAG AA at 390 to 1440 px.
- Company details (name, address, phone, fax, e-mail, WhatsApp) from
  siteSettings.company over built-in values, everywhere they appear, JSON-LD
  included; tel: links in E.164; form recipient stays in config.
- Services: a photo gallery with a self-hosted lightbox replaces the steps.
- Sell your vehicle: call, mail and WhatsApp buttons, a checklist and a short
  form instead of the 14-field form; each click is a taxatie lead and one
  request conversion.
- Fire engines (body type Feuerwehrfahrzeug) go to Brandweer; branch 1 (PKW)
  to Personenwagen, renamed from Auto with a 301 from /voertuigen/auto; the
  import prints counts per category before and after.
